description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for Downlink PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) PDUs in 5G NR, including parameters for maintenance, codewords, and the PDU itself.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_maintenance_parameters_v3
classes.description: Contains parameters for maintaining DL PDSCH, including pattern configurations and rate matching info.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_parameters_v4
classes.description: Holds parameters related to Coreset and CRS patterns for DL PDSCH.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_codeword
classes.description: Represents information about a codeword in the PDSCH, including code rate, modulation, MCS, and size.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_pdu
classes.description: Main structure representing a Downlink PDSCH PDU with all associated parameters, including bitmap, resource allocations, codewords, and optional context.
